errors.name: DepositTooSmall
errors.msg: First deposit must exceed the onboarding fee

errors.name: RoundInProgress
errors.msg: A round is already in progress

errors.name: WrongState
errors.msg: Instruction not valid in the current round state

errors.name: RoundGainTooHigh
errors.msg: This bet could win more than one round allows

errors.name: FraudSuspected
errors.msg: Rollup claim inconsistent with Solana's ledger

errors.name: MaxWinTooHigh
errors.msg: Max win above the allowed limit

errors.name: StaleRandomness
errors.msg: Randomness does not answer the pending request

errors.name: PromoCapReached
errors.msg: Promo payout above the pool's limits

errors.name: MissingTable
errors.msg: Blackjack needs the player's table account

errors.name: InvalidTile

types.name: BaccaratCoup
docs: Cards are ranks 1 (ace) to 13; empty slots are 0.

types.name: BlackjackHand
docs: Legacy single-hand blackjack state, never written since blackjack moved to
`BlackjackTable`. Kept only so `PlayerAccount` keeps its byte layout (accounts already
delegated, withdrawals deserialize it).

types.name: BlackjackTable
docs: The player's blackjack round: hands and dealer. Lives in the rollup next to the player
account; between rounds it keeps the last round for display.

fields.name: bet
docs: Base bet of every hand (a doubled hand stakes twice this).

fields.name: hands
docs: Every hand in playing order: a hand born from a split comes right after the one
it was split from.

fields.name: active
docs: Index of the hand to play while the round waits for the player; `n_hands` once
every hand is finished.

fields.name: splits
docs: Splits played this round, all hands together (at most `MAX_SPLITS`).

fields.name: min_bet
docs: Smallest stake; below it the 1% fee would round to nothing while Tilt still pays the round.

fields.name: max_bet
docs: Largest stake for one round, in USDC base units.

fields.name: max_round_gain
docs: Largest gain one round may produce (caps e.g. straight-up roulette and slot jackpots).

fields.name: max_player_win
docs: Largest lifetime net win reserved for one player.

fields.name: max_win_multiple
docs: A player's reserved max win may not exceed this multiple of their first deposit.

fields.name: onboarding_fee
docs: What Tilt advances in SOL to open an account, kept in USDC from the first deposit.

fields.name: min_deposit
docs: Smallest deposit after the first one. At least `min_withdrawal`, so a dust deposit
cannot be withdrawn right back through the "empty the balance" exception, each round
trip making Tilt pay a commit.

fields.name: min_withdrawal
docs: Smaller withdrawals are refused unless they empty the balance (each one costs a commit).

fields.name: max_withdrawal
docs: Withdrawals above this are held for review.

fields.name: player_daily_cap
docs: Paid automatically to one player per 24 h block; beyond it, their withdrawals are held.
Blocks are fixed, not rolling: up to twice this can go out around a block boundary.

fields.name: daily_cap
docs: House money (paid beyond players' own deposits) sent automatically per 24 h block.

fields.name: round_timeout_secs
docs: A round untouched this long can be closed by the relayer.

fields.name: validator
docs: The only rollup validator player accounts may be delegated to.

fields.name: vrf_queue
docs: The only MagicBlock VRF queue draws may come from.

fields.name: payouts_paused
docs: Holds every automatic payment (Tilt can still release after review).

types.name: HiloBoard
docs: The player's Hilo round. Lives in the rollup next to the player account; between rounds
it keeps the last round for display.

fields.name: max_gain
docs: Most this round can gain, the cap on its gross return.

fields.name: fair
docs: Fair multiplier (×`FAIR_ONE`), before the house edge.

fields.name: cards
docs: Cards drawn, the first `n_cards` count.

fields.name: guesses
docs: `guesses[i]` (a `HiloMove` code) led to `cards[i + 1]`.

fields.name: pending
docs: The guess awaiting its card (`HiloMove` code), `NONE` otherwise.

fields.name: busted
docs: The last card proved the guess wrong.

types.name: Ledger
docs: Solana's own record of a player, never written by the rollup. Claims coming back
from the rollup are checked against it.

fields.name: deposited
docs: USDC credited to the player on Solana (onboarding fee already deducted).

fields.name: forfeited
docs: Player losses released from the reservation (see `checkpoint`).

fields.name: max_win
docs: The player's win cap: set at the first deposit, raised by `raise_win_cap` as they win.

types.name: MinesBoard
docs: The player's Mines round. Lives in the rollup next to the player account; between rounds
it keeps the last round for display.

fields.name: revealed
docs: One bit per tile revealed safe (bit `tile`).

fields.name: order
docs: Tiles revealed safe, in reveal order; the first `n_revealed` count.

fields.name: pending
docs: Tile awaiting its draw, `NONE` otherwise.

fields.name: busted
docs: The mine that ended the round, `NONE` otherwise.

fields.name: max_gain
docs: Most this round can gain (`max_gain`), the cap on its gross return.

types.name: PlayerAccount
docs: The player's balance and current round. Lives in the rollup permanently.

fields.name: credited
docs: Deposits already credited from the ledger; never decreases.

fields.name: forfeited
docs: Losses released from the vault reservation by `checkpoint`; never decreases.

fields.name: withdrawn
docs: Total ever withdrawn; never decreases.

fields.name: fees
docs: Tilt's 1% fees taken from this player's winning rounds.

fields.name: max_payout
docs: Largest single payout.

fields.name: daily_cap
docs: Paid out per 24 h block (fixed blocks, like withdrawals).

types.name: PromoPayout
docs: One per payout id: a payout can never be made twice, whatever the relay does.

fields.name: player
docs: Owner of the token account that was paid.

types.name: QuickRound
docs: A one-draw round: the player's choice, and the outcome once drawn (zeros before).

types.name: QuickTable
docs: The player's last one-draw round, of any of the five games. Lives in the rollup next to
the player account.

fields.name: drawn
docs: The outcome in `round` has been drawn.

types.name: RouletteChip
docs: One chip of a `roulette_chips` spin: its own bet and amount.

fields.name: number
docs: 0 to 36 once spun.

types.name: RouletteTable
docs: The player's last `roulette_chips` spin: its chips, then the pocket once landed. Lives in
the rollup next to the player account.

fields.name: chips
docs: The first `n_chips` count.

fields.name: pocket
docs: 0 to 36 once landed, `NO_POCKET` before.

types.name: Round
docs: The current or last round. Lives in the player account, so an unfinished round
survives disconnections and can be resumed.

fields.name: stake
docs: Total stake, every blackjack hand, double and split included.

fields.name: request_id
docs: Id of the VRF request the round is waiting for; any other callback is refused.

fields.name: blackjack
docs: Legacy, always default: blackjack rounds live in `BlackjackTable`.

types.name: RoundSettled
docs: Emitted in the rollup when a round ends; with the account state, enough to display
and verify the round (replay `randomness` through the game rules).

fields.name: split
docs: Born from a split (both hands of the split): its 21 is not a blackjack, and split
aces (first card an ace) take no card after the split one.

types.name: TowerBoard
docs: The player's Tower round. Lives in the rollup next to the player account; between rounds
it keeps the last round for display.

fields.name: max_gain
docs: Most this round can gain, the cap on its gross return.

fields.name: climbed
docs: The tile picked on each safe level; the first `level` count.

fields.name: level
docs: Safe levels climbed.

fields.name: pending
docs: Tile awaiting its draw on level `level`, `NONE` otherwise.

fields.name: busted
docs: The tile that ended the round on level `level`, `NONE` otherwise.

types.name: Vault
docs: House state, on Solana. Owns the USDC token account that pays every player.

fields.name: admin
docs: Configuration, roles and house funds (meant to be a multisig).

fields.name: relayer
docs: Hot key of the relay: plays for players and pays fees. Rotatable by the admin.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives onboarding fees and house withdrawals.

fields.name: reserved
docs: What the vault may owe in the worst case: for every player,
deposited - forfeited - withdrawn_paid + max_win.
